verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports the Pull Request workflow (plus AGit) for submitting, reviewing and merging code, and that submitters can respond to review comments. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions forking repositories or contributions from outside, non-collaborator users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repository forking, cross-repository (fork-to-upstream) pull requests for external contributors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the fork-and-PR flow.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can let outside contributors fork my repository and propose changes back via pull requests

citations.quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow.
Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
